title: Nespresso Capsules Original Line, Kazaar Intenso, Dark Roast Coffee, 50 Count Coffee Pods
reviews: Perfect if you like intense, strong espresso that is neither bitter nor has an over-roasted burnt aftertaste. Leaves a delectable taste of undisputed quality and pleasurable, sybaritic indulgence in your mouth. Delicious aroma with a smooth, beautifully blonde, consistent and lasting crema. A perfect 10 for me.

Great go-go juice! If you like a spring in your step, this is a great way to start the morning. No need for multiple cups of coffee when one good one will do --unless you have a problem. :-) While Nespresso has a great variety of flavors, I like the taste and punch of the Kazaar pods. Strong. Dark. Just the right amount to get you through the day. Highly recommend the Kazaar pods.

These Nespresso capsules are my absolute favorite! The Intensity 13 has such a bold, rich flavor that gives me the perfect boost to start my day. The aroma is strong but smooth, and the crema comes out beautiful every time. I’ve tried different varieties, but I always come back to this one—it never disappoints. If you love strong, full-bodied coffee, this is the one to get.
My favorite brand. Love the strong taste. I don't drink any other brand.
Love this coffee, strong and dark just how I like it! Recommend 100%!

It’s a lovely espresso that is such a treat, I now have an overpriced indulgence in my life (jk, I drink 2 a day at about $2 each). I was drinking Peet’s 12, but this “Nespresso Capsules OriginalLine, Kazaar Intenso, Dark Roast Coffee” is soooo much better and not as bitter. I love it and highly recommend it if you like super rich creamy dark coffee with hints of cocoa and vanilla. Depending on whether you add anything to your espresso, it can go either way. I hope this helps!
